remarks: Convenient, spacious, bright townhouse condominium with 1 car garage and private patio. Tiled entry leads to garage access, storage, laundry and office. Main level has Living Room w/ FPL, built-in bookcases and access to rear patio. Kitchen features updated cabinets, granite countertops, S/S appliances (GE Profile) - refrigerator, range, microwave and JennAire dishwasher. Half bath completes main level. Upper level features two en suite BRs; Primary has full bath with dual sink vanity, jet tub and separate shower stall, tile floor. Primary has storage closet and two large clothes closets. Second BR has full bath with tile floor and 2 large clothes closets. Large garage. Excellent condition - move in ready.
